svg.title: DeineFraesmaschine CNC mill individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.

Budget all driver input current. Do not reuse an unidentified old controller auxiliary rail or connect motor voltage to logic.", "direction": false}], "note": "The X/Y/Z/A channel association shown is a proposed mapping only; machine drawing does not map each of four driver blocks to an axis. SN74LVC07A is 6-channel, pins: 1A/1Y=1/2, 2A/2Y=3/4, 3A/3Y=5/6, GND=7, 4Y/4A=8/9, 5Y/5A=10/11, 6Y/6A=12/13, VCC=14. Open drain tolerates \u22645.5 V and TI rates sinking up to 24 mA, but exact DQ860 installed input current is unverified: compare measured/spec current to TI guaranteed VOL/current test conditions before using. The +5V source +5 V and \u221236 V are different nets; do not join them without a verified topology. This proposal supplies PUL+/DIR+ from the new regulated 5V logic distribution, with its return wired to buffer/Core logic GND, so no unidentified old-controller supply contact is required. Driver motor power remains separate. Opto input current and timing still require measurement. U1 serves X/Y and U2 serves Z/A: four loaded sinks per IC, at most64mA at16mA per input, leaving margin below the 100mA absolute package limit. Do not reuse an unidentified old controller auxiliary rail or connect motor voltage to logic.", "direction": false}], "note": "The X/Y/Z/A channel association shown is a proposed mapping only; machine drawing does not map each of four driver blocks to an axis. SN74LVC07A is 6-channel, pins: 1A/1Y=1/2, 2A/2Y=3/4, 3A/3Y=5/6, GND=7, 4Y/4A=8/9, 5Y/5A=10/11, 6Y/6A=12/13, VCC=14. Open drain tolerates \u22645.5 V and TI rates sinking up to 24 mA, but exact DQ860 installed input current is unverified: compare measured/spec current to TI guaranteed VOL/current test conditions before using. This proposal supplies PUL+/DIR+ from the new regulated 5V logic distribution, with its return wired to buffer/Core logic GND, so no unidentified old-controller supply contact is required. text.tspan: DeineFraesmaschine CNC mill · individual conductor plan

svg.text: Dotted = GUESS / proposed conversion, verify before energizing · Green = retained source path · Broken = OPEN
Each circle is one named physical pin, terminal or identified lead. Connector orientation and fitted revision must match.
Crossing lines are not junctions. Connections exist only at the named terminal circles and explicitly shared nets.

text.tspan: DQ860 family axis X · buffered STEP/DIR input circuit

svg.text: The X/Y/Z/A channel association shown is a proposed mapping only; machine drawing does not map each of four driver blocks to
Open drain tolerates ≤5.5 V and TI rates sinking up to 24 mA, but exact DQ860 installed input current is unverified: compare
measured/spec current to TI guaranteed VOL/current test conditions before using. The +5V source +5 V and −36 V are different
nets; do not join them without a verified topology. This proposal supplies PUL+/DIR+ from the new regulated 5V logic
distribution, with its return wired to buffer/Core logic GND, so no unidentified old-controller supply contact is required.
Driver motor power remains separate. Opto input current and timing still require measurement. U1 serves X/Y and U2 serves
Z/A: four loaded sinks per IC, at most64mA at16mA per input, leaving margin below the 100mA absolute package limit. Verify
recommended VOL/current and temperature conditions, not just absolute maximum.

text.tspan: Hitachi WJ200 · Core PWM to O-L analog speed reference
Rf 20kΩ terminal A · U3 pin6 side
Rf 20kΩ terminal B · U3 pin2 side
Rg 10kΩ terminal A · U3 pin2 side

svg.text: Specific electronic proposal: R1=10 kΩ, C1=10 µF, OPA197 U3 SOIC-8: pin6 OUT, pin7 V+, pin4 V−, pin3 +IN, pin2 −IN; pins1/5/8
NC, Rf=20 kΩ and Rg=10 kΩ yield nominal gain 3.0 (0–3.3 V PWM average -> 0–9.9 V). It is not isolated, is not installed
hardware, and requires scope/ground-noise/transfer validation. No run/stop or safety function is provided. OPA197 SOIC-8 NC
pins 1, 5 and 8 are not connected. Fit local 100 nF bypass between U3 pins7 and4, plus nearby bulk capacitance chosen for
supply impedance. R1/C1 time constant is 0.1 s: verify ripple and speed response at chosen PWM frequency. Sequence supplies
so GPIO does not drive an unpowered stage; prove zero-command/startup output and loss-of-command shutdown.

text.tspan: Hitachi WJ200 · separate configured forward-run input and line/motor boundary

svg.text: The WJ200 terminal map includes P24/PLC and inputs 1–7. This proposal deliberately leaves the relay module model and
source/sink selection conditional; no 24 V terminal is directly connected to Smoothie. Keep NOT-Aus/guards/contactor chain
hardwired and independent. The 2.2 kW spindle power path uses correct nameplate mains/filter to VFD input and WJ200 U/T1,
V/T2, W/T3 plus PE to spindle; no mains contacts are guessed here. See the separate fully named ULN2003AN/AQY212GS
process-run proposal; no generic unspecified relay is needed.

text.tspan: Machine limits, references and NOT-Aus relay · source functions known, wire endpoints incomplete
X reference switch contact pair (terminal IDs
relay P10/GND sense plus separate +12V coil

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
OPEN
OPEN
OPEN
The plan depicts three references, six end switches, independent NOT-Aus and a relay with a sensing contact plus a separate
12 V coil chain. No pin/cavity contacts or NO/NC states are assigned. Keep OPEN until each wire and return is traced; never
route the E-stop coil through a Smoothie output.

Core P1 J24 · candidate X min
Machine X min end switch · plan
Core P1 J25 · candidate X max
Machine X max end switch · plan

svg.text: Functional proposal only: J24–J29 pin3 are mapped GPIO inputs with pin2 GND and pin1 selector/contact purpose to confirm.
J36/J37/J38 pin3 are exposed GPIOs; pin10 is GND. The machine plan shows one X/Y/Z reference plus min/max end switches, but
does not map specific wire/cabinet contacts. Therefore every proposed signal and return is dotted; identify each physical
switch wire, state and interface before wiring.

text.tspan: Isolated run LED drive · power, bias and every IC pin

svg.text: New engineering proposal: Core GPIO → ULN2003AN → AQY212GS LED, isolated contact pins3/4 to configured machine run circuit.
This slow process interface does not implement E-stop, STO or PWM. Verify startup inactive, receiver mode/current, isolation
layout and loaded off-state leakage before use. Nominal 390 Ω limits LED to approximately 5.5–9 mA using conservative 4.75 V
supply, 1.5 V LED and 1.1 V sink drop assumptions; recheck tolerance/temperature and actual sink voltage. AQY212GS
recommended LED5–30mA, contact≤48V/1A at25°C, derate by temperature; measured receiver current must fit. Contact is
bidirectional and galvanically isolated from the LED side: no logic ground crosses that barrier.

text.tspan: Isolated run contact · machine side only

svg.text: These contact pins belong to the same U6 used in the preceding LED-drive panel. The optically isolated contact side has no
conductor to Core or ULN logic GND. Retain independent hardware stop/safety. Verify receiver mode and off-state leakage; this
is a new unverified process-run proposal.

text.tspan: Buffer bypass and every unused CMOS input

svg.text: Same ICs as the preceding axis panels. Local 100nF bypass beside each VCC/GND pair; unused CMOS inputs tied to logic GND and
open-drain outputs left unconnected. Never feed opto +5V into 3V3 VCC. Measured package-current and GPIO/rail budgets must
fit recommended operating conditions.
Read the exact per-wire schedule, full contact inventory, parts, configuration and source checks in the accompanying profile.
